//: Live tests deliberately released from an obligation that internal/livegate otherwise enforces (T100). Every live test must be reachable from `make live` and named in AGENTS.md's live-test table; an entry here waives one or both, and must say why. `make gate` fails on an entry with no reason, on one naming a test that is not live, and on one whose obligation is in fact already met — a stale exclusion is how this list would rot into the silence it exists to prevent.

exclusions.reason: A vendor probe, not an oracle for claudia. It asks mcp.atlassian.com what auth it advertises and asserts the answer is OAuth with resource metadata — so it goes red when Atlassian changes its server, which is not a defect in this repo and must not be able to fail a claudia live gate. It keeps its AGENTS.md row under shared surfaces, because someone changing ProbeMCP should still be told it exists, and runs by name with CLAUDIA_MCP_OAUTH_LIVE=1.

A measurement probe, not an oracle. It drives one live Claude turn around a long silent tool call and prints the longest gap inside it — the quantity turnSilenceBound is set from — and asserts nothing, so running it on every live gate would spend a turn for a verdict it cannot give. Its own file says so. Run it by hand when the constant is questioned: `go test -run TestT96MeasureSilence -v -timeout 30m .` with the gates set. It keeps its AGENTS.md row under shared surfaces.
